switcher.title: Your workspaces
switcher.note: Switching the workspace switches the calendar, clients and settings too.

shell.closed: This section is closed to you

profile.title: My profile
profile.lead: Your {brand} account — the same in every workspace
profile.photoTooBig: {file} is {size} MB. Photos can be up to {max} MB.
profile.photoWrongType: {file} isn’t a photo. Use JPG or PNG.
profile.nameHint: Your teams see you by this name.
profile.phoneHint: You log in to {app} and {client} with this number. To change it, confirm the new number with a code.
profile.phoneHintFixed: You log in to {app} and {client} with this number.
profile.oldWorks: Until the new number is verified you can log in with the old one.
profile.taken: This number is used by another account
profile.ownerCantLeave: You’re the owner of {business}, so you can’t leave it. To close this workspace, contact {brand}.

leave.title: Leave {business}?
leave.text: You’ll stop seeing its calendar. Your bookings and requests stay with the business — the owner will choose who takes them.

login.title: Log in to {app}
login.lead: Enter your phone number — we’ll show you a 4-digit code. No password needed.
login.phoneHint: If you already book on {brand} as a client, use that number — one account works for both.
login.phoneHintDemo: Use the same made-up number on the {brand} site and here — one account works for both.
login.incomplete: The number is incomplete — it needs {digits} digits.
login.notMobile: Codes go to mobile numbers only. Enter a number starting with {starts}.
login.tooManyCodes: Too many codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.codeHint: It checks itself after the 4th digit.
login.codeExpired: The old code no longer works.
login.wrongCode: Wrong code. {left, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
login.locked: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

identity.title: Is this you, {name}?
identity.lead: This number’s account hasn’t been used for 6 months. Numbers sometimes pass to someone new, so we ask before you go in.
identity.ownsWorkspace: This account owns a business on {brand}, so it can’t start afresh here. Contact {brand} to sort out the number.

name.title: What’s your name?
name.lead: Your number is verified. Enter your name for your {brand} account — your team will see you by this name.

invite.title: {business} invites you to the team
invite.as: As {level, select, admin {an Admin} other {a Specialist}}
invite.admin1: You’ll see every calendar, booking and client
invite.admin2: You can answer requests and reply to reviews
invite.admin3: You can change services, prices and settings
invite.specialist1: You’ll see your own calendar and bookings
invite.specialist2: You can answer your own requests
invite.specialist3: You’ll see your own clients and earnings
invite.declineLead: {name} will be told. To join later you’ll need a new invite.
invite.declineLeadNobody: The business will be told. To join later you’ll need a new invite.

expired.title: The invite has expired
expired.lead: Each invite works for {days} days. The invite {business} sent on {sent} ended on {ended}.
expired.note: Ask the owner to send it again — the new invite will appear here.

empty.title: You don’t have a workspace yet
empty.lead: Open your business: calendar, online booking and a client list — free.
empty.note: Work at a business? Ask the owner to send an invite to your phone number — it will appear here.

opening.title: Opening {business}…
opening.one: We open the workspace you used last.
opening.many: You have {count} workspaces. We open the one you used last; pick another at the top of the left menu.

setup.title: Continue setting up {business}
setup.lead: You stopped at {step, select, business {your business details} address {your address} hours {your hours} services {your services} team {your team} rules {your booking rules} other {the last step}}. Everything you entered so far is saved.

login.demoNote: This is a demo of {brand}: the sign-in code shows here instead of an SMS. Use a made-up number, and don’t type in real people’s names or numbers.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The address may have a typo, or the page has moved.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.lead: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.

setup.title: Set up your business
setup.caption: 8 steps · about 5 minutes · free
setup.laterNote: Saves this step. Log in again and setup reopens right here.
setup.laterSaved: Saved. Log in again with {phone} and setup reopens at “{step}”.

phone.title: Welcome to {app}
phone.leadSms: Enter your phone number — we’ll send you a 4-digit code. No password needed.
phone.nameHint: For your {brand} account — your team will see you by this name. You’ll be the owner of the business.

business.title: About your business
business.lead: Clients find you by this name and category. The category also suggests starter services.
business.leadMore: Each workspace is one business at one address: its own calendar, team, clients and settings. Your {brand} account stays the same, and you’ll be the owner of the new business.
business.name: Business name
business.nameLong: Too long: up to {max, number} characters.
business.hintLong: Shorten the business name to {max, number} characters.

category.label: Category
category.searchPlaceholder: Search, for example: nails, dentist, tutor
category.noneText: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try another word, or tell us what you do.

address.title: Where will clients find you?
address.lead: Search for the address, then fine-tune the pin on the map. Clients use this pin to find their way.
address.byHand: Street · you place the pin yourself · {city}
address.tooLong: Too long: up to {max, number} characters.
address.pinLabel: Pin on the map. Move it with the arrow keys
address.areaLabel: The approximate area on the map. Move it with the arrow keys
address.dragPin: Drag the pin to fine-tune it
address.dragArea: Clients see only the approximate area — you can drag the circle
address.homeHint: Only clients with a confirmed booking see your exact address
address.homeNote: The exact address shows only after a booking is confirmed; until then the map shows the approximate area.
address.entrancePlaceholder: For example: through the courtyard, green door
address.entranceHint: This note helps clients find their way.
address.hintPick: Pick the address from the list.
address.hintLong: Shorten the address to {max, number} characters.
address.hintEntrance: Shorten the entrance note to {max, number} characters.
address.hintFloor: Shorten the floor and room to {max, number} characters.

hours.title: Your hours
hours.lead: Clients can book only within these hours. You’ll add staff shifts later.
hours.sameHint: Pick the time once for Monday–Friday

problems.sameTime: Opening and closing can’t be at the same time.
problems.intoNextDay: Closes after {next} opens. Pick an earlier time.
problems.breakOrder: The break must end after it starts.
problems.breakOutside: The break must be within your hours.

hours.hintNoDay: At least one day must be open.
hours.note: A day can close after midnight: 18:00–02:00 means open until 02:00 the next day. The part after midnight must end before the next day opens. You can add special days (holidays, closures) later in Settings.

services.title: Your services
services.lead: Pick from the ready list, then adjust each name, duration and price to suit you.
services.selected: {count, plural, one {# service selected} other {# services selected}}
services.noStarter: There’s no ready list for this category yet. Add your services below — 2–3 are enough to start.
services.name: Service name: {name}
services.settingsLater: Who does which service, descriptions and photos can be added later in Settings → Services.
services.hintPrice: Add a price to each service.

team.title: Who do you work with?
team.lead: With a team, each specialist gets their own calendar and clients can pick who they book with.
team.teamCaption: Each specialist gets their own calendar
team.soloNote: Clients won’t pick a specialist — every booking comes to you. You can invite people later in Settings → Team.
team.name: Name
team.phoneNeeded: Required for everyone. With the app on, it’s how they sign in.
team.notMobile: Mobile numbers only — enter a number starting with {starts}.
team.taken: This number is already on the team.
team.invited: They’ll see the invite when they sign in with {phone} · valid 7 days
team.noApp: Bookable at once, never signs in — you and admins handle their requests. They can start using the app later with this number.
team.phoneNote: Phone number: required for everyone. With the app on, it’s how they sign in. Invites work for 7 days; each person sees theirs when they sign in with the invited number.
team.specialistMeans: Sees their own calendar, bookings and clients; answers their own requests.
team.adminMeans: Manages the whole calendar and all clients; doesn’t see revenue.
team.appOffMeans: The specialist is bookable at once but never signs in. You and admins handle their requests.
team.permissions: See what each access level can do in Settings → Permissions.
team.addOrSolo: Add a team member or pick “I work alone”.
team.fixRows: Enter each person’s name and mobile number ({digits} digits).

rules.title: How should bookings arrive?
rules.lead: Confirm each new online booking yourself, or accept it at once.
rules.manualCaption: Every new booking arrives as a request
rules.instantCaption: The client is booked as soon as they pick a free time
rules.holdHint: If no one answers in this time, the request is cancelled and the client is offered other times. The time counts only while you’re open. The hold never runs past the visit’s start.
rules.whoHint: You have a team — who can confirm or decline online requests. You can always answer.
rules.whoNote: Requests for specialists who don’t use the app always go to you and the admins.
rules.instantNote: The client sees “Booking confirmed” at once. Block the times you’re busy in the calendar.
rules.cancelHint: Later than this, a client can only cancel by calling you.
rules.bufferHint: Free time kept after each service to get ready for the next client.
rules.settingsLater: You can change all of this later in Settings.

done.title: {name} is ready!
done.lead: Add bookings that come by phone or walk-in. Online booking opens after the review.
done.inReview: Your page is in review — only you and your team can see it. After the review it opens in search and at your link. You can use the calendar now.
done.switcherNote: The new workspace appears in the workspace switcher at the top of the left menu — switch back to {name} there.
done.previewLabel: After the review, clients see you like this
done.linkReady: Your link and QR code are ready — they open to clients after the review.
done.qrNote: Print it and put it by the till: after the review clients scan it with their phone and book straight away.

quality.title: Make your page stronger
quality.logoCaption: Shown next to your name in search and on your page
quality.photosCaption: The first photo is your card’s picture in search
quality.aboutCaption: Tell clients what to expect: services, products, experience

bookingRules.modeHint: Bookings you add yourself (by phone or walk-in) are always confirmed at once.
bookingRules.manualCaption: Every new booking arrives as a request. Until you confirm, the client sees “Pending”.
bookingRules.instantCaption: The client’s booking is confirmed at once. You just get a notification.
bookingRules.modeChanged: Requests already waiting keep their timers; new bookings follow the new setting.
bookingRules.holdHint: If no one answers in this time, the request is cancelled and the client is offered 3 other times. The time counts only while you’re open. The hold never runs past the visit’s start.
bookingRules.whoHint: Who can confirm or decline online requests. The owner can always answer.
bookingRules.whoDeskCaption: Specialists see their own requests but don’t answer them
bookingRules.whoEachCaption: Each specialist answers their own requests; admins only view them
bookingRules.whoBothCaption: Whoever answers first. The others see the answer at once
bookingRules.whoNote: A one-person business doesn’t see this setting — the owner answers every request. Requests for specialists who don’t use the app always go to the owner and admins.
bookingRules.leadHint: Clients can’t book a time closer than this, so you have time to get ready.
bookingRules.window: How far ahead clients can book
bookingRules.windowHint: Your calendar opens this many days ahead.
bookingRules.bufferHint: Free time kept after each service to get ready for the next client. Clients don’t see it, but can’t book into it. You can set it per service.
bookingRules.stepHint: Clients see free times like this: {times}…
bookingRules.cancelHint: Later than this, a client can only cancel by calling you.
bookingRules.reason: Ask clients for a reason when they cancel
bookingRules.reasonHint: The reason is optional for the client. You see it in the booking’s history.
bookingRules.late: Clients may be up to {time} late
bookingRules.lateHint: The same rule for every business on {brand}. Clients see it when they book.
bookingRules.noShows: Turn off online booking after no-shows
bookingRules.noShowsOffHint: Off: clients who didn’t come can still book online.
bookingRules.noShowsHint: After {n, plural, one {# no-show} other {# no-shows}} the client can only book by phone (“Phone only”). Switching Phone only off on the client’s card starts the count again. A new limit applies to every client right away.

link.lead: Send clients straight to your booking page.

state.liveText: Your page shows in search and opens at your link.
state.inReviewText: Your page opens to clients after the check. Until then only you and your team can see it.
state.hiddenText: Clients can’t find your page or open your link. Your calendar and bookings work as usual.

link.linkCaption: Put it in your Instagram profile, WhatsApp status or on your business card — clients book straight from it.
link.noLanguage: The link has no language in it: the page opens in each visitor’s language.
link.qrNote: Put it by the till — clients open it on their phone and book.
link.qrCaption: PNG for printing, SVG for designers.

permissions.lead: Permissions work by access level — give each person a level in <team>Team</team>.

rows.bookings: Add, move and cancel bookings; block time
rows.clients: See clients and their phone numbers
rows.clientsManage: Add and delete clients, “Phone only” switch
rows.settings: Change business settings (profile, rules, hours, link and QR)
rows.team: Manage the team (invite, remove, access level, “Uses the app”)

cells.ownClients: Own clients (with a booking with them)

permissions.noApp: Specialists who don’t use the app never sign in, so the table doesn’t apply to them.
